environment.Host: 4 vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.80 GHz cloud VM
environment.Database: PostgreSQL 16 on the same host, fsync on

headline.label: to capture one 100,000-event EPCIS document
headline.detail: ≈16,400 events/s. 33 MB of EPCIS 2.0 JSON-LD validated, deduplicated, rule-checked and committed in one transaction. Three runs: 5.97–6.10 s.

headline.label: serials allocated per second (FF1 random)
headline.detail: Through the API, including the database commit, on a busy host. 475k–530k/s when the host was idle; FF1 generation alone ≈658k/s.

headline.label: capture acknowledgement p95, 1k-event document
headline.detail: Budget: under 200 ms. Over HTTP with k6: 130 ms (1 client), 163 ms (2 clients).

headline.label: VRS verification p95 at 200 requests/s
headline.detail: Budget: under 1 s. k6 constant arrival rate, 0 failed requests.

rows.name: k6 capture, 4 clients, 1k-event documents
rows.notes: Over the 200 ms budget at this load on 4 vCPU; 18.6k events/s, 0 errors

howToReproduce: make -C backend bench                     # 100k capture, projection, allocation -> bench-results/
K6=$(command -v k6) VUS=2 scripts/loadtest.sh   # HTTP load: 1k-event capture and VRS
# Needs Go 1.26 and PostgreSQL 16 binaries (scripts/testdb.sh starts a throwaway instance).
